source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes i.i.d. observations, constructs a trimmed bias-corrected DR estimator, proves asymptotic linearity and a normal limit under its assumptions, and gives an ATE-specific design verification; it does not analyze arbitrary full-record Huber replacement.

The paper studies irregular weighted-moment identification, including an exogenous-selection treatment-effect example; rates depend on relative tail/support conditions when identification requires arbitrarily large weights.
robustate implements debiased trimmed IPW estimation and inference for the ATE under limited overlap, with a parametric propensity workflow and right-heart-catheterization illustration.
The article proposes density-power IPW/DR ATE estimators for outliers and states that a naive robust DR extension requires bias correction to retain double robustness.

The paper studies clean observational ATE estimation on hybrid smoothness and structure-agnostic classes, supplies minimax lower bounds, and gives a doubly robust estimator attaining its clean-class rate under conditions.
